EDITOR'S NOTE

This Wasn't The Plan. It Worked Anyway.

I want to be honest with you about something: this season didn't look anything like what I mapped out in January. Work got heavier before it got lighter. I had to make choices I didn't see coming. And somewhere in the middle of all that stretching, I realized I was still moving forward - just not on the road I'd drawn.

I used to think a "winning season" meant everything going according to plan. This year taught me the opposite. It meant choosing peace over pressure, even when pressure was louder. It meant choosing myself, even when that choice was hard and quiet and mine alone to make. It meant trusting that what God has for me doesn't require my original blueprint to survive.

So this issue isn't a highlight reel. It's the season underneath the highlight reel - the sanctuary I rebuilt one small luxury at a time, the health I started protecting on purpose, the peace I chose on repeat until it became a little more automatic.

If you're in a season that's stretching you right now, I hope this issue feels like a hand on your shoulder. Not because everything is figured out. Because it's working anyway.

"Even when it wasn't the plan, it was working the whole time."
The Simpli Edit Vol. 08 - The Winning Season
THE SEASON

Choosing Peace Over Pressure

Somewhere this year I stopped asking "what's the urgent thing" and started asking "what's the peaceful thing." They weren't always the same answer. Choosing peace didn't mean choosing easy - some days it was the harder option, the slower option, the one that made less sense on paper.

But every time I chose it, something shifted. Not instantly. Not dramatically. Just - a little more room to breathe than the day before.

What Pressure Sounded Like

"You should be further along." "Everyone else has it figured out." "Slow down and you'll fall behind."

What Peace Sounded Like

"You're exactly where you're supposed to be." "Rest is not the same as quitting." "The right things arrive on their own time."

"Peace over pressure isn't a mindset you master once. It's a choice you make again tomorrow."
The Simpli Edit Vol. 08 - The Winning Season
HOME

Recreating My Sanctuary

When everything else in life felt like it was in motion, my home became the one place I could control. Not with a big renovation budget - with small, deliberate, affordable-luxury choices, one corner at a time.

The Reset Ritual Corner

A single armchair, warm lighting, and nothing electronic in reach. This is where the day ends now - not scrolling, just sitting.

Fresh Flowers, Weekly

A standing rule: something living in a vase, every week, no matter how small the bunch. It changes a whole room.

Scent as Structure

One signature candle for evenings, one for mornings. The scent tells my body which part of the day it is before I even think about it.

DIY Affordable Luxury

Thrifted frames spray-painted gold. A tray from the dollar section styled like it cost ten times more. Luxury is in the arrangement, not the receipt.

Sanctuary Affordable Luxury DIY
The Simpli Edit Vol. 08 - The Winning Season
HEALTH & SELF

Protecting My Peace, Protecting My Body

I stopped treating my health like the thing I'd get to eventually. This season, it moved to the front of the line - not as a punishing overhaul, but as a quiet, consistent commitment to myself.

  • Morning movement before the inbox opens
  • Water before coffee, every single day
  • One meal a day cooked slowly, on purpose, no multitasking
  • A hard stop on work notifications after a set hour
  • Saying no without a paragraph of justification attached
"Taking care of myself stopped being a reward for finishing everything else. It became the thing that let everything else work."
The Simpli Edit Vol. 08 - The Winning Season
SIMPLI STYLED

Fall, Dressed & At Home

Fall is the season that finally lets everything slow down - including what we wear and how our homes feel. This edit blends both: the closet and the space it lives in.

Wardrobe: The Camel Coat Formula

One camel coat, three ways - over denim for errands, over trousers for meetings, over a slip dress for evening. The single-piece, multiple-outfit rule stays true all fall.

Wardrobe: Gold-Toned Layering

Cream, taupe, and gold-hardware pieces layered for warmth without losing the soft-luxury palette.

Home: Textural Warmth

Swap linen throws for something heavier - boucle, chunky knit - in the same neutral palette so the room transitions without a full redecorate.

Home: Amber & Gold Lighting

Warmer bulb temperature, one additional lamp per room. Small change, instant "sanctuary in fall" feeling.

The Simpli Edit Vol. 08 - The Winning Season
SIMPLI SIPS™ · EP. 13

The Strawberry Sunset Ritual

A bright strawberry lemonade meets fresh lemonade and a frozen strawberry ice bar that slowly melts into every sip. Sweet, refreshing, and made for the slow evenings when work is finally behind you.

Ingredients

½ cup Trader Joe's Organic Strawberry Lemonade · ½ cup fresh lemonade · Ice · 1 Trader Joe's Strawberry Lemonade Ice Bar

Optional garnish: fresh strawberry, lemon wheel, mint sprig

How To Make It

Fill a rocks glass with ice. Pour in the strawberry lemonade, add fresh lemonade, and stir gently. Place the ice bar directly into the glass. Sip immediately and let the frozen fruit slowly transform the drink.

"Sometimes slowing down starts with nothing more than a beautiful glass and ten uninterrupted minutes."
